title: Arreglos de combate · maná, Huir, Gemelos, Plasma y la noche
description: The fixes of 2026-11-23 (docs/combat.md § Maná, § Huir, § Reacciones entre elementos; docs/castle.md, Los Gemelos): Huir in the friends' missions and at night but not in their bosses, the Gemelos' health bar holding its width and the one felled alone staying down a round more, Plasma (Eléctrico on Quemado), an ánima in reserve getting maná back as soon as its wearer acts, and the night street lighting its pupils up and holding them still 2 s after a fight.

steps.eval: window.night = { g: () => window.gerard.game, s: () => window.gerard.game.nightStreet, n: 50, make(kind, dx, dz, more = {}) { const me = this.g().position, at = { x: me.x + dx, z: me.z + dz }; const p = { id: 'night-' + (++this.n) + '-1', group: more.group ?? 1, kind, position: at, facing: 0, mode: 'patrol', patrol: [{ x: Math.round(at.x), z: Math.round(at.z) }], next: 0, timer: 0, known: { x: me.x, z: me.z }, look: 0, seeing: false, stuck: 0, ...more }; this.s().pupils.push(p); return p; } }; const s = night.s(); s.tier = { ...s.tier, perTrain: 0 }; s.pupils.splice(0); night.g().standAt({ x: 112, z: 44 });

night.make('repetidor', 7, 3, { group: 2 }); night.make('chivata', -6, 4, { group: 3 }); night.make('gemelo', 5, -6, { group: 4, mode: 'chase', seeing: true }); night.make('empollon', 1.2, 0, { group: 1, mode: 'chase', seeing: true });

steps.caption: Caught on the Meridiana at night: Huir is in the menu
They run: the group that caught them stands still a while
Back on the street: every pupil about lights up where it stands (a ring at its feet, a flare, a second softer one halfway) and nobody moves for 2 s; then they hunt again
